Confirmed the tool uses integer numbering (Phase 3, not 2.1).

decisions.decision: Option B for CLAUDE.md vs .cursor/rules/ — keep both, pointer rule
decisions.rationale: GSD subagent prompts say 'Read .cursor/rules/ if exists' — none reference CLAUDE.md. Cursor already auto-injects CLAUDE.md as workspace rule. Created thin pointer file so both paths lead to the same source of truth (CLAUDE.md). Zero migration churn. Option A (full migration) deferred.

decisions.decision: Commit Phase 3 bootstrap separately from Phase 3 planning output
decisions.rationale: Two distinct logical units: 'Phase 3 defined as a roadmap entity' vs. 'Phase 3 broken down into executable plans'. Keeping them in separate commits means if planner output needs rework, roadmap/requirements plumbing stays intact.

decisions.decision: Push all 3 local commits before planning (not just the bootstrap commit)
decisions.rationale: Opening brief listed unpushed commits as non-blocking cleanup. Pushing before planning makes the remote a legitimate restore point; deferring creates a 4th unpushed commit for no reason. Branch is tracked, fast-forward only, no force push needed.

plan-phase.md step 4 explicitly says 'Do NOT invoke discuss-phase as a nested Skill/Task call' — it will route to top-level command and exit. Running discuss-phase first avoids wasted steps and produces a higher-fidelity CONTEXT.md for the planner to work from. Phase 3 has real design decisions to lock (load point, feature detection, rate-limit, regex sharing).
